generation.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: isolated transparent cutout for an interactive matcha packaging website. Brand typography will be rendered in HTML later, so the package must be COMPLETELY BLANK.
Primary request: one realistic premium SILVER resealable aluminium-foil stand-up food ingredient bag. Inspired by plain Japanese bulk matcha pouches: a generously wide flat front, crimped sealed top, three subtle horizontal resealable zipper ridges, softly folded side seams, a rounded stable gusseted base. Moderately tall, body width about 62 percent of its height. Substantial fine powder inside gives the bottom a soft full volume. The front is smooth and mostly flat with restrained natural creases at the edges, faint subtle highlight bands through the middle; not heavily crumpled. NO transparent window, NO paper label, NO sticker, NO typography, NO logo, NO black label panel, NO graphics or letters anywhere.
Composition: exactly one complete upright pouch, perfectly front-facing with negligible perspective so a real live text layout can be overlaid on the central front. The full top and bottom are visible. Centered vertical portrait framing about 2:3; moderate clear margins at all sides. Bag occupies roughly 88 percent image height, middle printable area broad and calm from 27 percent to 75 percent height.
Style: high-end controlled product photograph, bright satin silver metallic laminate with realistic specular edge reflections, neutral cool studio softbox, no tinted gold or green foil. Soft wide illumination across the front lets small black printed type read well. Beautiful detailed metal surface, quietly industrial, not chrome mirror, not plastic, not matte paper.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no backdrop, no tabletop, no stage, no environment, no cast shadow (the website adds its own). Only the bag cutout. No hands, people, scoops, tea leaves, powder spills or additional items. No certifications, markings, barcodes, watermark or brand.

cutout.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided blank silver pouch image. Keep the bag itself, its shape, zipper, natural silver foil detail, lighting, proportions and blank front exactly as they are. Remove ALL of the grey, white and black backdrop and ALL of the broad soft glow outside the physical bag silhouette. The result must have TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside a crisp clean silhouette following the pouch edges. No ground, shadow, halo, glow, opaque rectangle or checkerboard. Every background pixel beyond the bag edge must be fully transparent. Preserve the entire bag including top seal and curved base, no cropping. Do not add any text, label or window. This is a clean product cutout to place on a dark webpage.
